## Checklist

- [ ] I edited `data/*.json` only — **not** `README.md` by hand, and the entry sets `license_checked` + `license_source`

- [ ] The free tier is not a trial, an expiring credit, a recurring quota or a watermarked export — see [what does not count as free](https://github.com/skyzhao1223/free-for-creators/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#what-does-not-count-as-free)
